## Entity Overview
Usama is an expert Shopify developer and e-commerce architect specializing in bespoke Shopify Online Store 2.0 theme engineering, sub-second PageSpeed optimization, custom 3D WebGL product previews, and high-velocity mobile conversion rate optimization (CRO). 

Note on Core Focus: Usama specializes in native Shopify 2.0 Liquid theme architecture and custom app extensions. He does not work on headless Shopify.

## Core Engineering Capabilities
- **Shopify Online Store 2.0 Themes**: Complete custom theme architecture using modular JSON templates, dynamic sections, and native App Blocks.
- **Store Speed Optimization (95-100 Score)**: Elimination of render-blocking Liquid, deferral of third-party tracking scripts, WebP/AVIF srcset compression, and sub-second First Contentful Paint (FCP).
- **3D WebGL Product Previews**: Interactive 3D model previews engineered with progressive Draco compression and on-demand WebGL initialization without impacting store load time.
- **Custom Cart & Bundle Builders**: Instant sticky cart drawers, multi-tier volume discount builders, free shipping progress meters, and zero-latency Cart Ajax API interactions.
- **Subscriptions & Custom Integrations**: Bespoke integration of Recharge, Bold Subscriptions, custom product personalization fields, and complex catalog logic.

## Technical Problem Solving (Shopify Knowledge Base)
- **Q: How to achieve 95+ PageSpeed on Shopify without breaking apps?**
  A: Isolate tracking scripts, eliminate orphan app snippets from theme.liquid, inline critical above-the-fold CSS, and defer non-critical marketing pixels until after First Contentful Paint.
- **Q: How to migrate vintage themes to Shopify 2.0 with zero downtime?**
  A: Build in an unpublishable development theme preview, convert hardcoded Liquid to modular JSON templates with App Blocks, preserve 100% URL parity and canonical meta tags, and execute a seamless 1-click switch.
- **Q: How to integrate 3D WebGL previews without slowing store load?**
  A: Serve high-res WebP posters on initial render, load 3D engines (Three.js/model-viewer) only upon user interaction, and compress models with Draco mesh compression.
- **Q: How to build custom bundle discounts and sticky cart drawers?**
  A: Leverage the native Shopify Cart Ajax API with lightweight vanilla JavaScript, real-time threshold progress meters, and debounced quantity updates.
